commands.command:
set -eu
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user daemon-reload
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user enable --now node-hello.service
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user is-enabled node-hello.service
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 systemctl --user is-active node-hello.service

set -eu
resp=/tmp/node-hello-response
code=$(curl --silent --show-error --output "$resp" --write-out '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/")
printf 'http_code=%s\n' "$code"
printf 'body='; cat "$resp"; printf '\n'
printf 'body_bytes='; wc -c < "$resp"
printf 'body_hex='; od -An -tx1 "$resp" | tr -d ' \n'; printf '\n'
test "$code" = 200
test "$(cat "$resp")" = 'Hello, world!'
test "$(wc -c < "$resp" | tr -d ' ')" = 13
uid=$(id -u nodeapp)
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user is-enabled node-hello.service
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user is-active node-hello.service
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid podman info --format 'rootless={{.Host.Security.Rootless}}'
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid podman ps --filter name=node-hello --format 'container={{.Names}} status={{.Status}} ports={{.Ports}} image={{.Image}}'
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid podman exec node-hello id
ss -ltn '( sport = :8080 )'
rm -f "$resp"
